code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    markers=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1]
    for r in range(h):
        cols=[c for rr,c in markers if rr==r and (c==0 or c==w-1)]
        if len(cols)>=2:
            for c in range(min(cols),max(cols)+1): out[r][c]=1
    for c in range(w):
        rows=[r for r,cc in markers if cc==c and (r==0 or r==h-1)]
        if len(rows)>=2:
            for r in range(min(rows),max(rows)+1): out[r][c]=1
    return out
'''
